title: Your own account
lede: Instead of the workspace's key, the runs you start can use your own {engine} sign-in, one at a time. Thulu never sees what the sign-in stores.
warning: Every agent container a run of yours starts can read this login. Connect a personal account only on a self-hosted install you control.
meta_connected: {who} · runs you start use this login
meta_none: Runs you start use the workspace's key
meta_pending: The code from the sign-in page is still missing

modal.title: Sign in to {engine}
modal.prepare_note: The first time, Thulu installs it, which can take up to a minute.
modal.open_detail: It opens in a new tab. Approve the access and copy the code it shows you.

confirm.title: Disconnect your {engine} login?
confirm.message: The engine signs this login out and its volume is removed. Runs you start go back to the workspace's key.

errors.load: Could not load your own login.
errors.lost: The sign-in closed before it finished. Try again.
